text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: This is it. We've reached the finals.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We're facing <chrname> on a
stage
where she perhaps shines the
brightest of all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Right! After all the time we've spent
together, we
owe it to our trainees to
cheer them on with all
our might!
choice_data_list: お互い頑張りましょう！

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a little. I've been striving to have
you
succeed, and to show Trainer

<username> that I
have it in
me to exceed all expectations.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But I know we've both grown stronger
because of
this. We've been able to
overcome every loss and
conquer every
weakness. So I know you can do
this.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This time I'm ready. I've gotten so
strong
and fast.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Get out there, Meek. Show our strongest
rival
exactly what you're capable of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the URA Finale is about
to
begin!
